import random
from offline_discovery.banks import build_exact_bank, ExactLookup, exact_domains
class C:
 def __init__(self,cid,rng):self.cid=cid;self.length=len(rng);self.rng=rng
for trial in range(500):
 n=random.randint(0,15);cs=[]
 for i in range(n):
  L=random.randint(2,3);rng=[]
  for j in range(L):
   lo=random.randint(0,6);hi=random.randint(lo,8);rng.append([lo,hi])
  cs.append(C(i,rng))
 order=list(range(n));random.shuffle(order);ps=[cs[i] for i in order];rank={c.cid:i for i,c in enumerate(ps)}
 cap=100000
 entries,tables=build_exact_bank(ps,cap,rank)
 lookup=ExactLookup(tables)
 doms=exact_domains([c.rng for c in ps])
 for t in range(100):
  L=random.randint(1,4)
  key=tuple(random.randint(0,8) for _ in range(L))
  brute=[]
  for c,dom in zip(ps,doms):
   if c.length==L and dom is not None and all(any(lo<=key[j]<=hi for lo,hi in dom[j]) for j in range(L)):
    brute.append(c.cid)
  want=min(brute,key=lambda cid:rank[cid]) if brute else None
  m=lookup.match(list(key),L)
  got=m[0] if m else None
  if got!=want:
   print('exact fail',trial,key,got,want,[(c.cid,c.rng) for c in ps],entries,rank);raise SystemExit
print('exact lookup ok')
